meta.name: TutorFinder BD
meta.hosting: Vercel Hobby (project 'tutor-finder', GitHub auto-deploy on main)
meta.stack: Astro 5 SSR + Tailwind 4 + MDX + Supabase (free, NOT yet provisioned)

purpose: FREE DocTime-style review directory for Bangladesh tutoring, Dhaka-first: tutors enlist free (profiles by subject/level/area/mode/fee), students/guardians search & filter to find their perfect match, real user reviews gated by actual engagement, admin verification/moderation. SEO = acquisition channel. Monetization later & optional (featured/verified/match-service) — directory stays free.

blueprint.model: DocTime-style: free verified reviewable directory (doctors -> tutors)

verdict.summary: CONDITIONAL GO. Demand-side excellent (92% tutoring prevalence, ~38-40M students, <1% served by leader); trust gap in informal 'tuition media' is the opportunity. Generic Caretutors clone = NO-GO.

active.goal: Build TutorFinder BD (DocTime-style FREE review directory)
active.notes: MVP code built + deployed shell; needs Supabase provisioning + seed to go live

completed.goal: Study DocTime model + write real architecture/blueprint (v2)
Build full MVP codebase (schema + SSR app + endpoints) & deploy shell to Vercel

decisions.decision: Stack = Astro SSR on Vercel + Supabase free (Postgres/Auth/Storage/RLS)
decisions.rationale: User picked recommended A/B; zero ops

decisions.decision: MVP scope = FULL: enlist+profile+admin approve+public search+contact flow+gated reviews
decisions.rationale: User picked recommended A/B; trust loop day one
Astro 7 rolldown has no Android support; v5/esbuild has Android binaries (keeps local dev possible); identical on Vercel

decisions.decision: Supabase cookie adapter uses get/set/remove (not getAll)
decisions.rationale: Astro 5 cookies lack getAll (Astro 6+); @supabase/ssr supports deprecated interface
View must bypass RLS (owner privs) for public names + admin role check; profiles table stays select-denied

decisions.decision: Vercel project 'tutor-finder' + GitHub auto-deploy on main

preferencesAndConstraints.noFabrication: Tutor/area/fee figures must be sourced or flagged as placeholders
preferencesAndConstraints.gitRule: commit + push after any modification (global standing rule 5.6)
preferencesAndConstraints.language: English to user in Termux (D46); Bengali OK in published content

projectContext.codeLayout: Code at repo root (NOT site/): src/, supabase/migrations/ (0001_schema.sql verified, 0002_seed.sql), public/, docs/, memory/
projectContext.pages: home, search, tutor/[slug], areas/*, subjects/*, how-it-works, privacy, terms, join, login, guardian/dashboard, tutor/dashboard, tutor/edit, admin/dashboard
projectContext.endpoints: POST api/auth/{signup,login,logout}, api/tutor/save-profile(+photo), api/guardian/{request,cancel}, api/tutor/engagement-status, api/reviews/{create,reply}, api/admin/{decide-tutor,moderate-review}
projectContext.environmentQuirks: Android external storage CANNOT dlopen native addons (rollup/esbuild/oxide) -> NO local build/dev; builds only via Vercel. npm bin-links=false global. git safe.directory exception added. committer email manoftec-ai@users.noreply.github.com

workInProgress.status: MVP code fully written, plain-TS typechecked clean, deployed to Vercel (Build Completed, status Ready). Runtime UNVERIFIED: Supabase not provisioned; Vercel Deploy Protection (SSO) redirects public *.vercel.app traffic to SSO login (team setting).

nextSteps: USER: create free Supabase account+project; provide URL/anon/service-role keys (+DB password) -> apply migrations -> set Vercel envs (PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)
DECIDE: Vercel Deploy Protection (SSO) off for production OR custom domain (currently 302 to SSO)
After Supabase live: e2e verify register->tutor edit->admin approve->search->guardian request->tutor respond->review->moderation; set first admin role
Domain: tutorfinderbd.com / dhakatutor.com; set SITE_URL env
Ambient SEO later: sitemap, MDX blog, JSON-LD per area/subject
